name: Juice
author: thepathless
description: Bespoke animated battery widget with hardware charge targets (80% / 100%) and compact telemetry dashboard

barWidget.description: Hardware charge targets and detailed battery health

schema.label: Percentage inside the battery
schema.description: Print the level inside the battery body, the way iOS 16+ does, instead of beside it.

schema.label: Bar icon height
schema.description: Height of the battery in the status bar (Apple standard is 12–14px).

schema.label: iOS 27 borderless body
schema.description: Draw iOS 27's filled capsule — no outline, the body itself carries the track, fill flush to the edge — instead of the bordered iOS 16–26 style.

schema.label: Turn red at or below (%)
schema.description: Battery level at which the icon switches to Apple's red.

schema.label: Power saver at
schema.description: Engage the power-saver power profile when on battery at or below this percentage.
